sloka: मृत्यु काल उपमस्य आज्ञाम् राज राजस्य वानराः ।सुग्रीवस्य आययुः श्रुत्वा सुग्रीव भय शन्किताः ॥४-३७-१९॥
transliteration: mṛtyu kāla upamasya ājñām rāja rājasya vānarāḥ ।sugrīvasya āyayuḥ śrutvā sugrīva bhaya śankitāḥ ॥4-37-19॥

translations.english: In response to the command of the king, who was like death to them, the monkeys came at once, driven by fear from Sugriva.
